observations.action: Apply inline authored font-size in Code using only the keyboard, then Tab
observations.expected: Success returns focus to the edited value and Tab continues within its Code row.

observations.action: Escape a new Code draft, then Cancel it and Tab
observations.expected: Escape or Cancel discards the draft and returns focus to the value control.

observations.action: Apply native RGB authored Code color swatch
observations.expected: A native color edit creates an attributed session override, leaves authored source intact and participates in Undo.

observations.action: ArrowRight on expanded selected button, then ArrowLeft on its leaf child
observations.expected: Tree keys navigate expanded child/parent relationships as well as toggling branches.

observations.action: Pick slotted light-DOM label, inspect HTML, then open Navigator and refresh
observations.expected: The selected assigned node remains visible exactly once and its slot ancestry is traversable in both trees.

observations.action: Use actual HTML tree to select slot and Child to select assigned node
observations.expected: Visible slot nodes can navigate assigned content even when picked-node ancestry initially omitted it.
